orchestrator.description: Roster health audit: verify all 8 agents have reachable seats and valid bindings
orchestrator.expected_output: all 8 agents reported with status field

orchestrator.description: Model binding check: confirm each agent's model path resolves on its host
orchestrator.expected_output: 0 discrepancies or list written to cockpit-discrepancies.jsonl

orchestrator.description: Capacity gauge refresh: recompute fleet capacity from host-metrics.jsonl
Dependency graph update: rebuild schtask dependency snapshot
Fleet capacity report: summarize per-host load and goal velocity

researcher.description: Re-run stale_claim_scan over KB and flag citations older than 30 days
researcher.expected_output: stale citation list (empty or flagged entries)

researcher.description: Evidence quality trend update: append weekly evidence-quality score
KB index freshness check: verify index.md entry count matches file count
Source cross-validation sample: pick 5 KB entries, verify source URLs resolve
Dictionary gap scan: find terms used in goal files missing from glossary

builder.description: Orphaned temp file sweep: remove *.tmp and dot-prefixed files older than 24h in memory/
Build artifact size audit: flag any generated file over 500KB
Pin-file integrity check: verify pinned file hashes match manifest
CSS token drift scan: compare ui/*.css custom properties against design tokens
Test coverage delta: diff test file count vs last cycle, flag drops

verifier.description: Stale test battery re-run: execute all AC-0xx acceptance tests in memory/verifier/tests/
SLO history gap fill: backfill missing days in slo-alerts.jsonl from decision log
verifier.expected_output: gap count + filled entries (0 gaps expected)

verifier.description: Regression daemon health: confirm regression-watch task is registered and last ran <24h ago
verifier.expected_output: task status line with last-run age

verifier.description: Evidence chain audit: every 'Verified:' claim in TODO.md links to an existing file
Gate log compaction: compress gate decisions older than 7 days into weekly summary
verifier.expected_output: entries moved count + summary file path

designer.description: WCAG contrast spot-check: run contrast audit on all text/background pairs in ui/*.css
Breakpoint regression scan: render each page at 768px and 1440px, flag overflow
Icon set completeness: every data-icon attribute in HTML has a matching SVG symbol
Typography scale audit: all font-sizes in ui/*.css are multiples of the 4px base
Animation perf check: no CSS animation on layout-triggering properties (width/height/top/left)

archivist.description: KB coverage re-index: rebuild KB index from memory/knowledge_base/ and diff against committed index
Provenance report refresh: regenerate per-file provenance for last 7 days of commits
Dangling pointer sweep: find and fix pointers in INDEX.md that resolve to missing files
Orphan file detection: list files in memory/ not referenced by any index or pointer
Index staleness check: flag index.md entries whose target mtime is newer than the index commit

scribe.description: Fleet brief digest: regenerate the one-screen fleet status brief from live endpoints
Report rebuild: re-render latest cycle report from raw JSON (no manual edits)
scribe.expected_output: report file rewritten, byte-identical if data unchanged

scribe.description: Link check: verify all relative links in scribe-generated reports resolve
Template lint: validate report templates render with empty data without KeyError
Archive tidy: move reports older than 30 days into memory/ops/reports/archive/

mechanic.description: Latency snapshot: append current portal endpoint latencies to transition-latency.jsonl
mechanic.expected_output: one JSONL line appended with per-endpoint ms

mechanic.description: Scheduled task audit: compare registered schtasks against schtask-snapshot, flag drift
Restart guard dry-run: verify auto-loop restart guard blocks a double restart within 5 min
Egress scan: diff net-egress-log against allowlist, flag new destinations
Watchdog health: confirm watchdog.log has an entry within the last 10 min
